controls.label: Midas Ethereum DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, EOA 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227 also held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and could grant or revoke the mF-ONE mint-operator role without delay.

controls.label: Midas Ethereum upgrade path - 1/3 Safe through 2-day timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, all three mint-critical transparent proxies shared ProxyAdmin 0xbf25b58cb8dfad688f7bcb2b87d71c23a6600aac. Its owner was MidasTimelockController 0xe3eee3e0d2398799c884a47fc40c029c8e241852 with a 172800-second delay. Safe 0xb60842e9dabcd1c52e354ac30e82a97661cb7e89 was the timelock's sole proposer, executor, and canceller; it was 1-of-3 with no enabled modules and a zero guard.

review.evidence: The retained Ethereum block 25527148 review establishes direct minting by EOA 0x4f75307888fd06b16594cc93ed478625ad65eeea and DepositVault 0x41438435c20b1c2f1fca702d387889f346a0c3de, immediate DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE authorization by the 1-of-3 Safe and separate EOA, and the two-day timelocked ProxyAdmin. Original control pins and review start remain unchanged. Source-scope correction observed 2026-10-20: the engine announcement describes a general publication framework, while current documentation describes source/workflow fidelity and internal NAV consistency checks. The registry-linked October 20 checkpoint contains Fasanara note valuation and redemption correspondence, issuer-reported cross-chain supply, rounded protocol aggregates and a computed coverage ratio, but no complete note-to-token/pending-liability join on a committed cadence. The base report already records partial liability reconciliation. NAV checks and side-by-side operational records do not independently establish a token-liability-creation ledger procedure; internal-ledger is not inferred. Under the shared D33 evidence standard, reconciliation and supervision remain unknown, withdrawing unsupported periodic and attestation-only credit. No prudential issuer mandate is established. Direct minting and immediate minter authorization remain economically unbounded; no measured backing shortfall or absence of every reconciliation process is inferred.
